Class Diagnostics

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.Diagnostics
public class Diagnostics extends Object
A class that finds problems in a knowledge base. It is not meant to be instantiated.

    • membersNotInAnyPartitionClass

      public static List<String> membersNotInAnyPartitionClass(KB kb)
      Returns a list of terms, each of which is an instance of some exhaustively decomposed class but is not an instance of any of the subclasses that constitute the exhaustive decomposition. For example, given (instance E A) and (partition A B C D), then E is included in the list of terms to be returned if E is not a instance of B, C, or D.

    • termDependency

      private static Map<String,Map<String,List<String>>> termDependency(KB kb)
      Return a list of terms that have basic definitional information (instance, subclass, domain, subrelation, documentation) in a KB constituent that also uses terms defined in another file, which would entail a mutual file dependency, rather than a hierarchy of files.
      Returns:
      a TreeMap of file name keys and an ArrayList of the files on which it depends. The interior TreeMap file name keys index ArrayLists of terms. file -depends on->filenames -that defines-> terms

    • findOrphanVarsRecurse

      private static HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> findOrphanVarsRecurse(Formula f, HashSet<String> parents)
      Recursively traverses a formula to find variable co-occurrences.
      Parameters:
      f - the formula to traverse
      parents - variables from the outer level that should link to variables found here. e.g., when processing (agent ?X ?Y) inside (containsFormula ?ACK (...)), parents = {?ACK} so ?X and ?Y will link to ?ACK
      Returns:
      map of variable co-occurrences found in this formula and its subformulas

      private static HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> addLinks(HashSet<String> parents, Formula f)
      Creates bidirectional links between a variable and all parent variables. Example: if parents = {?A, ?B} and f = ?C, creates edges ?Cinvalid input: '<'->?A and ?Cinvalid input: '<'->?B
      Parameters:

    • addAllLinks

      private static HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> addAllLinks(HashSet<String> parentVars, HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> childrenMap)
      Connects parent variables to all child variables discovered in subformulas. Creates bidirectional edges between each parent and each child variable. Example: if parentVars = {?A, ?B} and childrenMap contains {?C, ?D}, creates edges ?Ainvalid input: '<'->?C, ?Ainvalid input: '<'->?D, ?Binvalid input: '<'->?C, ?Binvalid input: '<'->?D
      Parameters:
      parentVars - variables at the current level (e.g., direct args to a predicate)
      childrenMap - co-occurrence map from recursing into subformulas
      Returns:
      merged map with parent↔child edges added (no self-links)

    • mergeResults

      private static void mergeResults(HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> target, HashMap<String,HashSet<String>> source)
      Merges co-occurrence maps by combining neighbor sets for each variable. If a variable exists in both maps, their neighbor sets are unioned. If a variable only exists in source, it's added to target with its neighbors.
      Parameters:
      target - the destination map to merge into (modified in place)
      source - the source map to merge from (not modified)
